title: [CQ-R10d4] Agent headless launch spec
description:
Objective: make CQ-R10b's JOBS start the real CLIs headless, with the CQ-R10d1 shim as their only MCP server and a per-role prompt that begins with moe.get_context.

Split from CQ-R10d (task-90847011) on 2026-10-29. The human chose FULL ACCESS INSIDE THE VM. The VM, the moe-agent identity, NoNewPrivs and the scoped bridge are the boundary: claude runs with --dangerously-skip-permissions, and codex with --sandbox danger-full-access, because codex 0.148+ refuses every MCP tool under any sandbox when approval is 'never' (scripts/CLAUDE.md). It depends on:
- CQ-R10d1 (task-9faf1ef3), for the shim path /opt/moe/bin/moe-mcp-shim;
- CQ-R10d3 (task-b8e7ad92), which edits guest-supervisor.py first.

Contract (scripts/local-runner/guest-supervisor.py):
- JOBS[cli] gains a fixed argv template beside its executable and credential names. Keep the shape CQ-R10c's AGENT_JOBS drift test reads, or update that test in the same diff.
- claude:
  - start_job writes <home>/.moe-mcp.json naming only {"mcpServers": {"moe": {"command": "/opt/moe/bin/moe-mcp-shim"}}};
  - argv is [exe, '-p', PROMPT[role], '--mcp-config', <that file>, '--strict-mcp-config', '--dangerously-skip-permissions'].
- codex:
  - CODEX_HOME=<home>/.codex, whose config.toml has only the moe server pointing at the shim, with tool approval 'approve';
  - argv is [exe, 'exec', '--sandbox', 'danger-full-access', PROMPT[role]].
- Never a --resume, --continue or resume subcommand.
- The job runs in WORKSPACE. The config files are created in the fresh session home and owned by the agent, and no other MCP config is reachable: no user or project MCP files.
- PROMPT[role] are fixed strings for worker and qa, each starting with an instruction to call moe.get_context.

Out of scope: the binaries (CQ-R10d2/R10d3), lifecycle, leases and termination (CQ-R10), certification (CQ-R13), and any verified-local or isolation claim.

Verification command (fresh, exit 0 required): node --test scripts/tests/local-runner-bridge.test.mjs scripts/tests/local-runner-agents.test.mjs (on WSL: env -i with the nvm Node 24 PATH).
definitionOfDone: Each cli and role starts with exactly its fixed argv: headless, full access, no resume or continue flag, and the role's prompt beginning with moe.get_context. A recorder test pins it.

The session MCP configuration names only the shim (claude with --strict-mcp-config; codex's config.toml with only the moe server). It is created in the fresh session home and owned by the agent. Shown by tests.
A real job through main() with a fake CLI shows the argv, cwd WORKSPACE and the configuration file contents. Shown by tests.
The verification command exits 0 with its output supplied to complete_task.
taskRails: No direct .moe edits; no Git-write commands by agents; wrappers own landing.
Do not enable verified-local or claim isolation until all requisite implementation and certification gates pass.

implementationPlan.description:
TESTS FIRST (red). Load test-driven-development.

In scripts/tests/local-runner-bridge.test.mjs, beside the CQ-R10b J rows (about line 1163), reuse:
- bridgeJob with the RECORD recorder that stands in for relay() (about line 1181);
- the HELD probe harness, which runs a real executable through main(['bridge']) with jobs = {cli: (probe, names)} (about line 1278).

- LA1 (DoD 1): for each cli in {claude, codex} and each role in {worker, qa}, the recorded argv is EXACTLY:
  - claude: [exe, '-p', PROMPTS[role], '--mcp-config', <home>/.moe-mcp.json, '--strict-mcp-config', '--dangerously-skip-permissions'];
  - codex: [exe, 'exec', '--sandbox', 'danger-full-access', '--skip-git-repo-check', PROMPTS[role]].
  No element is or starts with '--resume', '--continue' or 'resume'. Each prompt starts with 'Call moe.get_context'; the worker and qa prompts differ and hold no credential. A table row pins PROMPTS' exact text.
- LA2 (DoD 2), using the same recorder runs. The fresh session home holds exactly:
  - claude: ['.moe-mcp.json'], whose JSON deep-equals {mcpServers: {moe: {command: '/opt/moe/bin/moe-mcp-shim'}}};
  - codex: ['.codex'] containing exactly ['config.toml'], whose text equals the three-line [mcp_servers.moe] table: command = the shim, default_tools_approval_mode = "approve". Also job.env.CODEX_HOME === <home>/.codex.
  Every created entry is owned by the job uid and is mode 0600 (file) or 0700 (dir). HOME is that fresh home, so no other MCP config is reachable.
- LA3 (DoD 3): through HELD, a real probe CLI run by main(['bridge']) prints its sys.argv, os.getcwd() and both config files' bytes.
  - Assert the argv as in LA1, cwd == WORKSPACE, and the bytes as in LA2.
  - It runs with QA_JOB (codex) and JOB (claude).
- LA4 drift:
  - set(m.LAUNCH) == set(m.JOBS);
  - set(m.PROMPTS) == set(m.JOB_ROLES);
  - m.SHIM equals guest-bootstrap.mjs GUEST_LAYOUT.shim (CQ-R10d1);
  - B17 still passes UNCHANGED, because the JOBS 2-tuple shape is kept.

Run `node --test scripts/tests/local-runner-bridge.test.mjs` and confirm the new rows fail for the missing tables or argv.

scripts/local-runner/guest-supervisor.py: the headless launch spec. First read the LANDED bytes of CQ-R10d3 (agents mode) and CQ-R11f (verify mode), and keep them intact.

1. Constants beside JOBS (about line 762), which keeps its (executable, credential names) shape:
   - SHIM = '/opt/moe/bin/moe-mcp-shim', mirroring GUEST_LAYOUT.shim;
   - PROMPTS = {'worker': ..., 'qa': ...}, fixed strings. Each begins 'Call moe.get_context for your assigned task first.', then says the role: the worker follows nextAction and the approved plan and finishes with moe.complete_task; QA reviews against the definition of done and finishes with moe.qa_approve or moe.qa_reject;
   - LAUNCH, a dict keyed like JOBS that describes each cli's argv tail and session files.
2. A helper, prepare_launch(cli, role, home, uid, gid, exe), returns (argv, extra_env). It writes the session MCP config into the FRESH home from session_home(), through a home directory fd opened with WALK:
   - each file: os.open(name, O_WRONLY|O_CREAT|O_EXCL|O_NOFOLLOW, 0o600, dir_fd=...), a write loop, fsync, then fchown(uid, gid);
   - codex's '.codex': os.mkdir(..., 0o700, dir_fd=...), reopened with WALK, then fchown.
   - claude: .moe-mcp.json = json.dumps({'mcpServers': {'moe': {'command': SHIM}}}).
   - codex: .codex/config.toml = '[mcp_servers.moe]\ncommand = "' + SHIM + '"\ndefault_tools_approval_mode = "approve"\n', with extra_env {'CODEX_HOME': home + '/.codex'}.
   - argv exactly as in LA1. '--skip-git-repo-check' is there because the materialized WORKSPACE has no .git (R09c copies files only). Confirm it from the pinned codex binary's `exec --help` (CQ-R10d2); if that version lacks the flag or the check, drop it and update LA1.
3. In start_job, after session_home, call prepare_launch. Its OSError returns os.EX_OSERR (71) with no frame and no job, exactly like a missing session home. Merge extra_env into env, then call relay(argv, ...) instead of relay([exe], ...).
4. Update start_job's comment and its exit-code list, plus the module header.

This step's error handling: nothing from the job frame reaches argv except the role's fixed prompt; the credential stays env-only. No resume or continue path exists. The check, verify, agents, materialize and export modes are unchanged.

ADVERSARIAL SELF-REVIEW, once, as the final step. Load adversarial-self-review. Read the diff as a hostile workspace and agent. Check:
- Can a candidate file in WORKSPACE add an MCP server?
  - claude: --strict-mcp-config ignores .mcp.json and settings.
  - codex: does the pinned version read a project .codex/config.toml when CODEX_HOME is fresh with no trusted projects? Confirm it from the pinned codex version's docs or behavior and record the answer. If it does read one, refuse a workspace with .codex/config.toml (exit 65), or pass the version's override; never assume.
- Can a symlink or pre-existing file in the fresh home redirect the config write? (O_EXCL, O_NOFOLLOW and dir_fd; and the home is fresh per job.)
- Does the credential appear in argv, a file or the prompt? It must be env-only.
- No resume or continue under any role.
- --dangerously-skip-permissions runs only as moe-agent, never as root; the identity drop is unchanged.
- The other modes are byte-identical; no .moe edits; no verified-local or isolation claim.
Report every path in complete_step.modifiedFiles, and write the Serena handoff memory 'task-task-60626bee13034a178fed55c697d14d06-handoff' for CQ-R10 and CQ-R13 (task-f4811a72).

executionContract.intendedBehavior:
A bridge job starts its real agent CLI headless, with full access inside the VM, with the CQ-R10d1 shim as its only MCP server and a fixed per-role prompt that begins with the instruction to call moe.get_context.
- claude: -p <prompt> --mcp-config <home>/.moe-mcp.json --strict-mcp-config --dangerously-skip-permissions.
- codex: exec --sandbox danger-full-access --skip-git-repo-check <prompt>, with CODEX_HOME=<home>/.codex whose config.toml names only the moe shim with tool approval 'approve'.
The config files are created O_EXCL|O_NOFOLLOW in the fresh session home and owned by the agent. The job runs in WORKSPACE. There is never a resume or continue.
acceptanceCriteria: LA1: exact argv per cli and role, with no resume or continue token and the pinned prompt prefix.
LA2: the exact config files and contents, owned by the job uid with 0600/0700 modes, in the fresh home; CODEX_HOME set for codex.
LA3: a real probe CLI through main() shows the argv, cwd WORKSPACE and the config bytes.
LA4: LAUNCH and PROMPTS key drift, the SHIM path mirror, and B17 unchanged.
invariants: The JOBS (executable, credential names) shape is unchanged, so B17 and AGENT_JOBS stay valid.
The credential reaches the job only through env; argv carries only the fixed template and the role's fixed prompt.
Config files exist only in the fresh per-job home; a creation failure is 71 with no job started.
Every other supervisor mode is byte-identical; nothing under .moe; no verified-local or isolation claim.
compatibility: guest-bridge.mjs AGENT_JOBS and jobFrame are unchanged; the host job frame shape is unchanged.
approvedScope: scripts/local-runner/guest-supervisor.py: SHIM, PROMPTS, LAUNCH, prepare_launch, and start_job's argv and env merge.
reuse: The dir-fd, O_EXCL and O_NOFOLLOW file creation idiom already in scripts/local-runner/guest-supervisor.py (materialize).
The codex MCP table convention of scripts/moe-agent.sh.
sourceAssumptions: scripts/local-runner/guest-supervisor.py JOBS (about line 762) maps cli to (executable, credential names); start_job (about line 820) builds env and spawn, then calls relay([exe], ...); session_home creates a fresh 0700 home chowned to the job uid.
scripts/local-runner/guest-supervisor.py main() forwards keyword seams (jobs, workspace, sessions, identity, agent_socket) from Python only.
scripts/local-runner/guest-bridge.mjs AGENT_JOBS mirrors JOBS; the B17 test in scripts/tests/local-runner-bridge.test.mjs unpacks `(_, names)` from m.JOBS.
scripts/tests/local-runner-bridge.test.mjs RECORD (relay stand-in) and HELD (real probe through main) harnesses around lines 1163-1300.
scripts/moe-agent.sh writes codex [mcp_servers.moe] with default_tools_approval_mode = "approve" (about line 986).

planningNotes.approachesConsidered:
- Extending JOBS to 3-tuples: rejected. It breaks B17's `(_, names)` unpacking and the AGENT_JOBS mirror. A separate LAUNCH table keeps the drift tests unchanged, which the description allows.
- Writing the config into WORKSPACE: rejected. It would sit in the candidate tree, reach the export, and could be overwritten by candidate files. The fresh per-job home is private.
- Adding --skip-git-repo-check to codex argv is a deliberate deviation from the description's argv. codex exec refuses to run outside a git repository without it, and the materialized WORKSPACE has no .git. The worker confirms it against the pinned binary; if the pinned version does not need it, it is dropped.
planningNotes.codebaseInsights:
- R10d1 (task-9faf1ef3) adds GUEST_LAYOUT.shim '/opt/moe/bin/moe-mcp-shim' and installs it 0555.
- R10d3 (task-b8e7ad92, unplanned) adds the 'agents' mode and /opt/moe/agents/<cli> binaries; JOBS executables already point there.
- R11f (task-5b0a2bcf) adds the 'verify' mode. dependsOn R10d3, R10d1 and R11f serializes all three edits of guest-supervisor.py.
- The bridge scopes every tool call to the job binding, so an argument-less moe.get_context reaches the bound task.
- Tests run the real supervisor module under python3 -I -B with seams; Windows skips them via NO_GUEST.
planningNotes.risks:
- codex project-config loading under a fresh CODEX_HOME is version-specific. Confirm it, or refuse a workspace .codex/config.toml.
- claude refuses --dangerously-skip-permissions as root. The job must run as moe-agent, which start_job's identity drop already ensures.
- A pre-planted path in the home: O_EXCL and O_NOFOLLOW make it 71, never a write through a link.
- A prompt wording change breaks LA1's pins on purpose; keep the prompts fixed constants.
- POSIX python3 is required. On WSL, use env -i with a Linux PATH.
